title: Exploring Vietnam with FREE Snorkelling Experience at Phu Quoc
highlights: Explore Vietnam’s diverse landscapes from Saigon to Hanoi, combining cultural experiences with thrilling adventures across the country’s most iconic destinations.
Climb to Fansipan Mountain, the highest peak in Indochina, standing at 10,326 ft, offering breathtaking panoramic views of lush valleys and towering mountains.
Cruise the stunning Halong Bay, kayaking through serene lagoons and hidden caves amidst towering limestone islands.
Immerse in Hoi An’s vibrant atmosphere, with Phu Quoc's crystal-clear waters and get a chance to see diverse marine life closely.
overview:
About the Tour:
Embark on an unforgettable 14-day cycling journey from Saigon to Hanoi, traversing Vietnam's vibrant landscapes. This tour takes you from the bustling streets of Ho Chi Minh City through serene coastal routes, lush paddy fields, and historic towns like Hue and Hoi An. Experience cultural landmarks, including the ancient citadel of Hue and the iconic Halong Bay. With opportunities for local interactions, scenic boat rides, and immersive cycling experiences, this tour combines adventure with a deep dive into Vietnam’s rich history and natural beauty.

know_before_you_go: Smoking is prohibited in most public areas therefore, designated smoking areas should be used.
Images are for representation purposes only.
Kindly carry a valid photo ID proof. All foreign nationals must carry their passport as proof of identity.
Please note that prices are dynamic and may change during peak season and blackout dates.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the stay property will be charged at actuals.
Kindly do not litter and help keep the destinations clean.
Please note that the timings and duration of pick-up and drop-off transfers may vary based on certain factors like traffic, weather conditions, natural calamities, etc.

If in case any traveller wants to or decides to leave the trip in the middle, all the expenses from the point onwards will be borne by the traveller. Neither the operator nor Thrillophilia will be held responsible for such decisions or for any refund.
It is recommended that you purchase travel insurance. Please note that the travel insurance is not included in the package price.
The official currency of Vietnam is the Vietnamese Dong (VND). It’s advisable to carry some cash for small purchases, though credit cards are widely accepted.
It is advisable that you dress modestly (keeping your upper arms and legs covered) when visiting any religious sites.
Always carry tissue paper or wet wipes with you as most public toilets in Vietnam do not provide them.
To mitigate health risks, it is strongly advised to refrain from drinking tap water directly in Vietnam. Instead, carry refillable water bottles.
Indian tourists can obtain a Vietnam visa online (E-Visa) or upon arrival at the airport with a validity of 30 days. Charges have to be paid by the tourists.

As per Indian Govt. rules, a Tax Collection at Source (TCS) of 5% for Foreign Remittance shall be paid additionally that you can claim while filing the income tax returns. Kindly consult a tax advisor/consultant for further information.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Hanoi | Leisure Day
days.desc: Welcome to Hanoi! Upon arrival at Noi Bai International Airport, board the transfer to the hotel to check in. The remaining day is for you to explore the city on your own. Visit places like Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, known as the resting place of the Vietnamese revolutionary leader. Explore the Temple Of Literature to witness the traditional Vietnamese architecture, and the Quan Su Temple, which reflects the allure of Vietnamese Buddhism. Later, head back to the hotel on your own for a night stay.

days.title: Transfer to Hanoi | Cat Cat Village Tour
days.desc: Today, check out of your Hanoi hotel and transfer to Sa Pa, where you'll check in at your hotel. After some relaxation, gear up for a trek to Cat Cat Village, home to the Black H'mong ethnic community. Along the way, explore the stunning Tien Sa Waterfall and visit the historic Hydraulic Power Station, all while soaking in the picturesque scenery. After a fulfilling day, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day Trip to Ninh Binh
days.desc: Prepare for an unforgettable day trip to Ninh Binh. Begin by exploring Hoa Lu, Vietnam's ancient capital, where you'll visit historic temples dedicated to King Dinh and King Le. Next, journey to Tam Coc often referred to as "Halong Bay on Land," and enjoy a scenic boat ride through rice fields and limestone rock formations. After this enriching experience, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Halong Bay Overnight Cruise
days.desc: Get ready for a wonderful cruise adventure. After checking out of the hotel, get transferred to Tuan Chao Harbour and board your Halong Bay cruise. Sail through beautiful landscapes, stopping at the Ti Top Island, and the Pearl Farm Village. Engage in activities like kayaking, and swimming, and immerse yourself in Vietnamese culture with a cooking class. End your day with an overnight stay in your comfortable cabin.

items.desc:
Board the cruise for Halong Bay from Tuan Chao Harbor and check-in into your cabin. Enjoy the scenery while sipping the welcome drink. Reach Tiptop Island and relax. 
Explore Pearl Farm Village by boat and enjoy water activities like Kayaking and swimming in the bay. Return to the cruise. Afterwards, join the cooking classes on Vietnamese-styled food. 
Enjoy the overnight stay at the cruise.

days.title: Halong Bay to Hanoi | Transfer to  Da Nang
days.desc: Wake up to a beautiful sight, surrounded by emerald waters and towering limestone formations. Start your day on the cruise with an exciting fun Tai Chi lesson, a traditional Chinese martial art. Afterwards, go on a boat ride to explore Halong Bay's largest and most impressive caves, the Surprise Caves. Once your exploration is complete, return to Tuan Chau Harbour and get driven to Noi Bai International Airport for your flight to Da Nang. Upon arrival, get dropped off at the hotel to check in.

items.title: Halong Bay Half-Day Cruise on a Shared basis
items.desc:
Begin your day by practicing Tai Chi, the Chinese martial art, on the Sundeck. 
Next, explore the seven new wonders of the world in Halong Bay.
Next, take a small passenger boat to reach Surprise Cave (Sung Sot), Halong Bay's largest cave spanning 12,000 square meters and admire its natural scenery.
Get back on the cruise and head to Tuan Chau Harbor.

days.title: Day Trip to Ba Na Hills
days.desc: Embark on a sightseeing tour of the stunning Ba Na Hills. Begin with a transfer from your hotel to Suoi Mo Station, where you'll enjoy a scenic cable car ride to Marseille Station, soaking in the panoramic views along the way. Upon arrival, immerse yourself in the beauty of Ba Na Hills, with highlights like the iconic Golden Hand Bridge, renowned for its unique architecture and scenic backdrop. Also, visit Linh Ung Pagoda, and Fantasy Park before returning to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Phu Quoc | Leisure Day
days.desc: On this day, get ready for a trip to Phu Quoc. After checking out, head to the Da Nang International Airport for your flight to Phu Quoc. Upon arrival at Phu Quoc International Airport, get transferred to your hotel and check in. After some rest, explore Long Beach, known for its pristine sands and clear waters, where you can enjoy swimming and parasailing. As the day winds down, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Phu Quoc Island Day Tour with Snorkeling
days.desc: Get ready for the exciting Phu Quoc South Island Tour! Get a transfer from your hotel to An Thoi Harbour, where you’ll board a speed boat to explore Gham Ghi, Buom, and May Rut Trong Islands. Dive into the crystal-clear waters around Gham Ghi and Buom for snorkelling among vibrant marine life. Then, unwind on the shores of May Rut Trong Island. After a day of adventure and relaxation, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Ho Chi Minh City | Leisure Day
days.desc: After checking out of your hotel, transfer to Phu Quoc International Airport for your flight to Ho Chi Minh City. Upon arrival, check in at the hotel and enjoy the rest of the day at your own pace. Explore Bui Vien Street for its lively bars, clubs, and restaurants, or the Dong Khoi Street, known for its vibrant nightlife. Consider attending a puppet show at the Golden Dragon Water Puppet Theatre at your own cost. Later, return to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Mekong Delta Tour
days.desc: Prepare for an exciting day as you transfer to My Tho city, passing through lush rice paddies. Upon arrival, visit Vinh Trang Pagoda, the largest pagoda in the Mekong Delta, known for its impressive architecture and gardens. Continue your adventure by embarking on a boat ride along the Mekong River, where you'll observe fishermen using fish cages from their unique floating houses and explore Tortoise Islet. Afterwards, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Mui Ne Sand Dunes Experience | Leisure Day
days.desc: Get ready for a stunning experience as you're transferred from the hotel to the mesmerising sand dunes of Mui Ne. While there, visit the enchanting Fairy Stream and soak in the coastal charm with breathtaking ocean views (at an extra cost). After a wonderful day, board your transfer back to the hotel. Later, explore Ho Chi Minh City at your own pace, visiting iconic spots like Ben Thanh Market, Notre Dame Cathedral, and Bitexco Tower. Conclude your day with an overnight stay at the hotel.

days.title: Leisure Day in Ho Chi Minh City
days.desc: Enjoy your leisure time in Ho Chi Minh City by exploring its famous attractions at your own pace. Stroll along Pham Ngu Lao Street, a bustling hub of local eateries and shops. Explore history at Giac Lam Pagoda, renowned for its ancient statues, or visit the Mariamman Hindu Temple, admired for its intricate architecture. You can also explore Vinh Nghiem Pagoda, known for its beautiful halls and serene gardens, among other attractions. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, check out of the hotel and get transferred to the Tan Son Nhat International Airport to board your flight for an onward journey. This is where your trip comes to an end.
